children: Japan Airlines needs stronger 2H results to achieve annual guidance, Jefferies analysts say in a note. The bank says 2Q results were incrementally positive, with EBIT above consensus and full-year guidance maintained despite a significantly tougher fuel and FX environment. The recovery in 2Q was supported by the airline's ability to pass on higher costs through fares and fuel surcharges, the analysts say. Its international cargo business remained strong, supported by robust AI-related Asia-North America demand. That said, Jefferies remains cautious as fuel and foreign-exchange remain meaningful earnings risks. The bank maintains a buy rating and a target price of 3,800 yen. Shares closed Monday at Y3,033. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
